figurative_meaning_en: The awakening of inner vision or insight
example_sentences_in_bangla: বইটি পড়ে আমার চক্ষুদান হলো সত্যিকারের জ্ঞানের গুরুত্ব সম্পর্কে।
example_sentences_in_english: This experience led to an awakening of his inner vision.
Reading the book was a true eye-opener about the value of knowledge.
note: Figuratively used to denote gaining profound insight, often in literary or reflective contexts; literal sense relates to modern organ donation awareness in Bengali society.
